title: Alien in Retro Pod
description: A green reptilian alien with purple hair and yellow sunglasses sits inside a metallic spherical pod, wearing a patterned scarf. The surreal landscape features a colorful lollipop-like tree with melting spheres, floating patterned orbs, a dripping red celestial body, and a swirling wooden floor with checkered and dotted balls.
